description: This file defines a static class 'AdoNetInvariants' that holds well-known invariant names for different database providers, used within the Orleans project for ADO.NET storage implementations. It also maintains a collection of these invariants for supported database types.

classes.name: AdoNetInvariants
classes.description: A static holder for vendor-specific ADO.NET invariant name constants, and a collection of supported invariants.

methods.name: Invariants
methods.description: A property returning a collection of supported database provider invariant strings.
